name: Xiamen International Airport Co.,Ltd
summary: Xiamen International Airport Co.,Ltd engages in airport operations in China. Its route network covers various cities in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, as well as Southeast and Northeast Asia, Europe, the United States, Africa, and Australia. The company provides domestic and international air transport services; ground support services for enterprises and passengers; property services; and aviation information services. It is also involved in the leasing and management of aviation business premises, commercial premises and office premises in the terminal building.
